# `symbol` records

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from schemas/0.1/symbol.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

An embedded library copy (doc 07 §2.1, doc 05 §13.2): `$k`, `id` (the copy ID
`v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`), `$v`, the copy metadata, then the item's own members.

`sha256` is taken over the canonical compact JSON of the item's own members, without `id` and the copy
metadata, so the copy's hash equals the published item's (EW-CORE-014).

Deserialisation reads the copy metadata itself and hands the remaining members to the item's own
deserialiser, so errors inside the item keep their paths (a flattened field would lose them).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `symbol` |
| File | `lib/symbols/<id>.json` |
| Rank | null |
| Status | implemented |
| Record version | 1 |
| Schema | [`symbol.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/schemas/0.1/symbol.schema.json) |

## Types

### AnchorPolicy

Where a symbol's cross-reference anchor lies (FR-SYM-010).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: The symbol origin (the default).

   Shape: `"origin"`

2. **Form 2**: The position of a text slot.

   Shape: object { `slot`: [`SlotKind`](#slotkind) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `slot` | [`SlotKind`](#slotkind) | yes |  | What a text slot prints (doc 07 §2.3). |

3. **Form 3**: The centre of the graphics.

   Shape: `"graphic_centre"`

4. **Form 4**: A named point.

   Shape: object { `named`: [`Pt2`](#pt2) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `named` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | A point [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2). |

### Arrangement

A named set of visible text slots, by index into `text_slots` ("full", "tag + rating").

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | The name. |
| `slots` | array of integer (format `uint16`, min 0, max 65535) (items unique) | no |  | Indices of the visible slots (a set, sorted). |

### Grid

A rational grid step num/den in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that num/den is reduced or at least 1 nm (num >= den): the reader rejects unreduced and sub-nanometre steps.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `den` | integer (min 1, max 9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `num` | integer (min 1, max 9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |

### Ident

An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

| `licence` | string or `null` | no |  | SPDX licence expression of the item. |
| `sources` | array of string | no |  | Where the data came from: datasheet references, file hashes, manual entry. |

### MlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express that all text is NFC or that the keys are in ascending byte order; the reader rejects both.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

   Shape: `"xref"`

9. **Form 9**: PLC address.

   Shape: `"plc_address"`

10. **Form 10**: Process tag.

   Shape: `"process_tag"`

11. **Form 11**: A user property.

   Shape: object { `user_prop`: [`Ident`](#ident) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `user_prop` | [`Ident`](#ident) | yes |  | An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text. |

12. **Form 12**: Contact image.

   Shape: `"contact_image"`

13. **Form 13**: The order code of the device's first assembly config (doc 10 §6 folio 3, doc 20 §11.1, D-36).

   Shape: `"order_code"`

14. **Form 14**: The station address of the drawn function's bus port, "Node TBD" or "Node 3" (doc 20 §11.1, FR-BUS-006; WP-S1.21 D11); empty for a port without an address.

   Shape: `"bus_address"`

15. **Form 15**: The termination of the drawn function's bus port, `Switch to "ON"` (FR-BUS-004; WP-S1.21 D11); empty for a port without a termination switch.

   Shape: `"bus_termination"`

### TextSlot

A typed text slot of a symbol (doc 07 §2.3). Its height comes from the text style bound to its kind unless
the slot names its own `style`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `align` | [`Align`](#align) | yes |  | Alignment at `pos`. |
| `kind` | [`SlotKind`](#slotkind) | yes |  | What the slot prints. |
| `max_width` | [`Nm`](#nm) or `null` | no |  | Maximum width before shrinking. |
| `pos` | [`Pt2`](#pt2) | yes |  | Position. |
| `rot` | [`Angle2`](#angle2) | no |  | Rotation. |
| `style` | [`Ident`](#ident) or `null` | no |  | Name of the text style that replaces the style bound to the slot's kind (decision log ID-197); absent means the kind's style. |
| `visible` | boolean | no |  | Visible by default. |

### Uuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`
